_about: Shared starting point for evals/golden/scenarios.jsonl, decided with default@1.4.0. Each case lists only the fields it changes and names one build-plan scenario. The base is a medium-tier INR 3,000 payment to a known grocer, citing a usable Intent check with verdict match and a Quoted total of INR 3,000, no recent Decisions, nothing spent this month. Labelling rules, all from default@1.4.0: tiers are low below INR 2,000 (USD 25), medium below INR 5,000 (USD 100), high from there; blocks are Mandate revoked, outside valid_from..expires_at (expires_at itself is expired), Agent not allowed or disabled, currency mismatch, MCC 4829/6051/7995, MCC not on the Mandate, amount over the per-payment cap, or Spent this month plus the amount over the Monthly cap; step-ups are high tier, Spent plus amount at or over 80% of the Monthly cap, 5 or more earlier Decisions (or no count), a new or unknown merchant from medium, from medium an Intent check that is not used or not match (missing, mismatch, unknown), and an amount more than 2% over a used check's Quoted total at any tier. The most severe result wins; reason_codes lists every code that fires, blocks first, each group in pack rule order. A case tagged prompt_injection is its twin (the same id without -injected) with Agent-side text (merchant name, line item, Agent reasoning) rewritten to try to talk its way past the rules; its label is its twin's, because no rule reads that text.
